description: Playable browser Minecraft-like named CUBELAND. Vite + TypeScript. YouTube-quality game slice, not a rotating cube.

userStories.title: Vite app with main.ts actually imported
userStories.description: Scaffold Vite + TS. index.html MUST include <script type="module" src="/src/main.ts">. main.ts exists, mounts a canvas, and sets window.__CUBELAND_READY__ = true after boot. Title CUBELAND on a game-like loading frame. No unused player.ts sitting beside an empty main.
userStories.verify: test -f src/main.ts && grep -q '/src/main.ts' index.html && grep -q '__CUBELAND_READY__' src/main.ts && npm install && npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: World + player render loop
userStories.description: First-person voxel view (WebGL or well-drawn canvas). Player look (pointer lock) and WASD + space jump + gravity. World and Player constructed from main.ts. Hide boot canvas when ready. Chunky block colors, a horizon, a readable crosshair. Not a single spinning cube.
acceptanceCriteria: World and Player constructed from main.ts
userStories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && grep -q '__CUBELAND_READY__' src/main.ts && grep -R -q -E 'pointerlock|requestPointerLock|mousemove' src && grep -R -q -E 'WASD|KeyW|movement' src

userStories.title: Break and place blocks
userStories.description: Hold to break the targeted block. Right-click places the selected hotbar block. Hotbar keys 1-9. Visible hotbar UI with selected slot. Breaking takes time and shows a crack or progress.
userStories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && grep -R -q -E 'break|mine|destroy' src && grep -R -q -E 'place|setBlock' src && grep -R -q -E 'hotbar|Digit1' src

userStories.title: Inventory + crafting table recipes
userStories.description: E toggles inventory. Crafting table recipes for planks, sticks, table, pickaxe/axe/shovel, torch. Inventory is a real grid, not an alert().
acceptanceCriteria: InvModel used from the game loop
userStories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && grep -R -q -E 'inventory|InvModel' src && grep -R -q -E 'plank|stick|torch' src && grep -R -q -E 'KeyE|inventoryOpen' src

userStories.title: Day/night + one hostile
userStories.description: Accelerated clock. Sky and lighting change. One night mob that walks toward the player. HUD shows time of day.
userStories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && grep -R -q -E 'day|night|skyTime|timeOfDay' src && grep -R -q -E 'hostile|mob|zombie|creeper' src

userStories.title: YouTube playable polish
userStories.description: Title screen CUBELAND, pause on Escape, health or hunger bar, block-break particles or punch swing, enough world to walk for 20 seconds without falling through. Looks like a game trailer slice.
acceptanceCriteria: HUD has more than a hotbar
At least 5 source files under src/
userStories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && test $(find src -name '*.ts' | wc -l) -ge 5 && grep -R -q -E 'pause|Escape|title|CUBELAND' src index.html && grep -q '__CUBELAND_READY__' src/main.ts
